title: Fix or remove `Polygon2D` `antialiased` property
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 31.82 GiB memory

### Issue description

Enabling the `antialiased` property for `Polygon2D` does nothing. It does not enable any kind of antialiasing, it does not produce any kind of error.

This property should either be fixed or if it cannot be reliably fixed on common platforms then it should probably be removed alltogether. As far as I can tell the recommended way to get antialiasing is using something like MSAA anyway, so the property isn't strictly necessary.

PS: Some older discussions of this mention issues due to HDR (e.g. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/46465). As far as I can tell HDR is disabled by default in Godot 4.5 and the `antialiased` property still doesn't work.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create `Polygon2D`.
2. Add some points.
3. Check `antialiased` in property inspector.
4. Run game and observe that the polygon is not antialiased.

N/A
